name: Houtou Sennyo ~Amai Shiru no Yuuwaku~
original_name: 放蕩仙女 ～甘い汁の誘惑～
source:
Main character is an ordinary student. He dates a cute girl Nana for over a month, but they aren't even holding hands yet. One day a loli girl appears before him. She claims to be a goddess of love and sacrifice who came to help make his ambitions fulfilled. She passes him a pill saying that it will help make all the girls he likes belong to him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名普通学生。他和可爱的女孩娜娜约会了一个多月，但他们甚至还没有牵手。有一天，一位萝莉女孩出现在他的面前。她自称是爱与牺牲的女神，来帮助他实现野心。她递给他一颗药丸，说这会让他喜欢的所有女孩都属于他。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
